Jenz is an AI platform for commerce teams. It connects to the systems your store runs on and gives the team one workspace to ask questions across all of your data, build apps on live numbers and automate recurring work. The Jenz agent works inside that platform and takes on tasks for the team, in the tools you already use. What are Jenz apps? Apps are internal tools that Jenz builds from a plain description. Ask for a view of which products will sell out and when, your real margin per product after freight, fees and ads, or revenue per campaign, and Jenz builds it on your live data and keeps it current. Titanbar × Jenz · Case study Skip to content Platform Jenz agent Customers Company Log in Book a demo Platform What Jenz does across your store Jenz agent The AI teammate that comes with it Customers Stores already running on Jenz Company The team behind Jenz Book a demo Log in Customer story · Titanbar How Titanbar hands 90 hours of work a month to Jenz. 90 h of work to Jenz every month 6 areas of work handed over Company Titanbar Industry Strength-training equipment Sells Direct to consumer Titanbar is a Norwegian strength-training brand run by its two founders. Social media, SEO, ads and bookkeeping used to be work they would have had to hire for. Today Jenz does it: 90 hours of work every month, so the founders can spend their time on selling and new markets. The situation Two founders and a long list of work that is not selling: social media, SEO, ads reporting, bookkeeping admin. Before Jenz, the only way to get it done properly was to hire someone for it. Until then, the founders did all of it on top of selling. What Jenz does 01 Social media analysis Which posts work, which do not, and why. Jenz tells the founders when something changes and what to do more of. 02 Replies across channels Every morning, the new comments and messages from every social channel in one place, with a drafted reply for each one. 03 Content and scheduling Jenz picks the images, sets the posting strategy and schedule, then creates and publishes the posts. 04 SEO A monthly report on keywords, rankings, search trends and competitors, a strategy Jenz adjusts as the numbers move, and one article a week. Titanbar had never had time for SEO before. 05 Meta Ads Reports on spend and results, suggested optimizations, and answers to any question about the ads, asked straight from Slack. 06 Accounting Connected to the accounting system. Jenz finds and fetches invoices, sorts them and does the bookkeeping groundwork. The result Titanbar now sets aside 90 hours of work a month for Jenz. Work that used to call for a new role runs every day, and the founders spend their time on what grows the brand: selling, and taking it into new markets. “ One thing is that Jenz saves us hours. What it does first and foremost is let us do much more without more people. It is a one stop shop that actually works. I do not need to sit and build it myself, I can spend my time selling. ” Christian Aass Co-founder and CEO, Titanbar Next customer story How Go On Shop got 31% more capacity from a team of two.
